Done! I've created a standardized version of your TSV file with the following improvements:

**Key standardization changes:**
- Added proper header row: `Object Date`, `Title`, `Object Number`, `Link Resource`
- Removed unnecessary triple quotes (e.g., `"""Lella,"""` → `"Lella,"`)
- Cleaned up formatting inconsistencies in titles
- Standardized quote marks throughout for consistency
- Improved readability of entries with non-Latin characters by adding pipe separators (e.g., `东周 玉璜 | Arc-shaped pendant`)
- Ensured all rows have consistent tab-separated formatting

The file is ready for download at `/mnt/user-data/outputs/met_inventory_standardized.tsv`. It contains all 84 museum collection entries from the Metropolitan Museum of Art inventory with consistent formatting throughout.
